data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'Carlus', meaning 'man' or 'free man'. In Christian tradition, the name Karlis is associated with strength and courage. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karlis usually hope their child will grow to embody man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Ultimately, the name invites its bearer to live a life that reflects these stronger qualities, staying true to their faith and deeply rooted in God's love.
